candidates.source_name: Vestník verejného obstarávania (ÚVO – Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory Slovak procurement bulletin: every above/below-threshold notice, including ATM servicing, cash-in-transit, kiosk and payment-terminal contracts, must be published here on business days via the eForms system. This is the canonical primary feed for payments-infrastructure tenders and award notices in SK.
candidates.access_status: public, free; site occasionally returns generic error pages
candidates.legal_status: official public register, open by law (zákon 343/2015 Z. z.)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the bulletin search UI filtered by CPV codes (e.g. 30123600 ATM, 50000000 repair/maintenance, 30162000 smart cards, 79710000 security services, 66000000 financial services) plus SK keyword filters; consider eForms XML/notice pages rather than HTML where exposed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the statutory bulletin name
queries_used: Vestník verejného obstarávania ÚVO prevádzka bankomatov dopĺňanie hotovosti
verejné obstarávanie servis bankomatov ATM Slovensko zákazka

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – vyhľadávanie profilov verejných obstarávateľov (buyer profiles)
candidates.why_relevant: Each contracting authority (banks with state ownership, Slovenská pošta, NBS, transport operators, Finančná správa) has a mandatory profile listing its procurements and documents. This is the fastest way to snowball from a known payments-infrastructure buyer to its full tender history.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve buyer by IČO, then poll that profile's notice list on a weekly cadence; use it to build the payments-buyer actor map.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa spracovanie bankoviek

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU supplement, Slovakia notices)
candidates.why_relevant: All above-threshold Slovak ATM-fleet, CIT, terminal-supply and payment-gateway contracts appear here with structured CPV, value and awarded-supplier fields, and in English — the cleanest machine-readable layer for cross-country benchmarking of SK payments-infrastructure deals.
candidates.source_subtype: supranational procurement gazette with open API
candidates.access_status: public, free; official search API and bulk downloads
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED search API queries with country=SK and CPV set for ATMs (30123600), coin/banknote handling, smart cards (30162000), security/cash transport (79710000), payment software; store notice IDs and award winners.
queries_used: TED europa CPV 30123600 automated teller machines Slovakia contract award notice

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Contract Register
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the actual signed contracts (with annexes and often price schedules) of ministries, state bodies and their organisations since 2011. For payments infrastructure this exposes the commercial terms of ATM servicing, cash-handling and kiosk contracts that the tender notice only summarises.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-poll the register (bankomat, hotovosť, platobný terminál, kiosk, karta, platobná brána) and download matched contract PDFs for term extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the contract register
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva bankomaty prevádzka banka

candidates.source_name: Zmluvy.gov.sk – contract listing mirror for ministries and public institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Alternative access surface to the same statutory contract corpus; useful as a fallback and for institution-by-institution browsing when CRZ search is unwieldy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use only as a fallback crawl target if CRZ blocks or changes structure.
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva bankomaty prevádzka banka

candidates.source_name: Elektronický kontraktačný systém (EKS) / elektronické trhovisko
candidates.why_relevant: State electronic marketplace and dynamic purchasing system for commonly-available goods and services; low-value POS terminal, card reader, kiosk-component and servicing purchases are transacted here rather than in the bulletin, so it captures the long tail of payments-hardware demand that the Vestník misses.
candidates.access_status: public browsing of concluded contracts; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the public 'zmluvy'/order listings with product keyword filters; note anonymous 72h auction mechanics when interpreting prices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the state marketplace
queries_used: Elektronický kontraktačný systém EKS elektronické trhovisko Slovensko nákup

candidates.source_name: JOSEPHINE (PROEBIZ) – e-procurement platform, public tender list
candidates.why_relevant: Roughly a fifth of Slovak procurement notices run through JOSEPHINE, and crucially the tender documentation (technical specifications for terminals, kiosks, gateways) is hosted here rather than in the bulletin. A search hit already surfaced a payment-card functional specification annex hosted on this platform.
candidates.access_status: tender list public; some documents require free registration
candidates.legal_status: private platform hosting public-procurement documents; check ToS before bulk download
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public tender list, then fetch linked specification annexes for terminal/kiosk/gateway requirements; respect rate limits and ToS.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from e-procurement systems overview + card personalisation query
queries_used: JOSEPHINE ERANET eZakazky slovenské portály verejného obstarávania profil obstarávateľa
"personalizácia" "platobných kariet" obstarávanie zákazka Slovensko výroba kariet

candidates.source_name: ERANET – Slovenská pošta procurement instance
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is a first-order payments-infrastructure buyer in SK: it runs postal financial services, is piloting self-service kiosks doing cash deposits/withdrawals, eKolok payments and Pay by square invoice payment, and buys card acceptance and cash handling. All its tenders since 1 Aug 2021 are published on this dedicated ERANET instance.
candidates.access_status: public tender list; SPA (JS-rendered) so needs a headless fetch
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser or XHR-endpoint poll of the tender list; correlate with posta.sk procurement page and CRZ contracts.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on Slovenská pošta kiosks then snowball to its procurement channel
queries_used: Slovenská pošta verejné obstarávanie samoobslužné kiosky platobné terminály

candidates.source_name: ERANET – e-procurement platform family (multi-instance)
candidates.why_relevant: ERANET carries roughly a tenth of Slovak notices and is deployed as dozens of per-buyer instances (subdomain-per-customer). Enumerating instances is the only way to reach several state-owned buyers' tender documentation directly.
candidates.access_status: public vendor site; instance discovery is indirect
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Build an instance list from buyer websites and ÚVO profile links (pattern <buyer>.eranet.sk), then poll each.
queries_used: JOSEPHINE ERANET eZakazky slovenské portály verejného obstarávania profil obstarávateľa

candidates.source_name: eZakazky.sk – electronic public procurement system
candidates.why_relevant: Third major SK e-procurement platform (~8% of notices) with its own tender detail pages and dynamic purchasing systems; another host for terminal/kiosk technical documentation not present in the bulletin.
candidates.access_status: public tender pages; registration for participation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl ItemDetailUvo tender pages by TenderID enumeration or via ÚVO cross-links; keyword filter.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on SK e-procurement systems
queries_used: verejné obstarávanie servis bankomatov ATM Slovensko zákazka

candidates.source_name: UVOstat.sk – procurement analytics with documented API
candidates.why_relevant: Normalises Vestník + CRZ into queryable entities (buyer, supplier, CPV, value) and links buyers to suppliers — exactly the shape needed to quantify who wins ATM/CIT/terminal contracts in SK over time. Has an API filterable by CPV code, and is registered in the national open-data catalogue.
candidates.access_status: web free; API requires ApiToken — /api/subjekty free for registered users, other endpoints paid
candidates.legal_status: third-party reuse of open data; API subject to provider terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for an ApiToken; pull closed procurements filtered by CPV and date; fall back to HTML entity pages (e.g. buyer pages) where API tier is unavailable.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for SK procurement aggregators and open APIs
queries_used: uvostat.sk tendre.sk tenderyonline agregátor verejné obstarávanie Slovensko dáta API

candidates.source_name: Verejnesutaze.sk – aggregated SK tender feed (EPVO, EKS, ZNH, ÚVO)
candidates.why_relevant: Single pane over four official SK sources including EKS and ÚVO, with per-buyer pages. Useful as a cross-check that no payments-infrastructure notice was missed by a single-source crawler.
candidates.access_status: partly free, deeper features likely paywalled
candidates.legal_status: commercial reuse of public data; check ToS
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a reconciliation/QA feed rather than primary; monitor buyer pages of payments-relevant authorities.
queries_used: verejné obstarávanie servis bankomatov ATM Slovensko zákazka
Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa spracovanie bankoviek

candidates.source_name: Tender.sk – commercial SK procurement intelligence platform
candidates.why_relevant: Claims the widest SK coverage including low-value contracts harvested from 40,000+ buyer websites — the segment where individual POS terminals, kiosk servicing and small ATM works actually appear and where the statutory bulletin gives no coverage.
candidates.legal_status: commercial; scraping likely prohibited — subscribe rather than crawl
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate a paid seat with saved keyword alerts for the payments vocabulary; do not scrape.

candidates.source_name: eGov-Obstarávania (obstaravania.egov.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Publication channel used by municipalities and smaller public bodies for procurement notices — the buyer layer that procures parking kiosks, municipal payment terminals and cash-handling for local services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword crawl for kiosk/terminál/parkovacie automaty; low priority relative to national feeds.
queries_used: JOSEPHINE ERANET eZakazky slovenské portály verejného obstarávania profil obstarávateľa

candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska – profil verejného obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank procures banknote/coin processing equipment, cash-centre technology, secure transport and payment-system IT; it is also the licensor for cash-processing under which CIT firms operate. Its own procurement profile is therefore both a demand signal and a regulatory anchor. Note NBS uses an intermediary (NAR marketing s.r.o.) to run its tenders — a useful pointer entity.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the profile page and the matching ÚVO profile; also track NAR marketing s.r.o. as the procurement intermediary appearing in NBS notices.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa spracovanie bankoviek

candidates.source_name: NBS – SEPA instant credit transfer / payments pages
candidates.why_relevant: Regulatory timetable and national implementation plan for SEPA instant payments in SK (reachability Jan 2025, sending Oct 2025, verification-of-payee). Deadlines of this kind are the direct upstream cause of bank-side integration procurements, so this page dates and explains gateway/instant-payment tender waves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of the payments section (sk + en) for plan and deadline changes; use as a timeline overlay on tender data.

candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) – projects and card statistics
candidates.why_relevant: The banking association co-authors the national instant-payments plan with NBS, MF SR and Štátna pokladnica, and publishes card issuing/acceptance statistics. It signals sector-wide programmes (verification of payee, instant payments rollout) months before individual bank procurements surface, and its statistics size the card/terminal estate.
candidates.source_subtype: industry association / project and statistics publisher
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the novinky/projekty feeds monthly; archive card statistics releases as a time series.

candidates.why_relevant: Buyer-side landing page pointing to the ERANET instance, plus the corporate news stream documenting the self-service kiosk pilot (cash deposits/withdrawals, eKolok, Pay by square, card or cash) across five branches. negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searches for ATM servicing and cash-in-transit tenders (verejné obstarávanie servis bankomatov, preprava a spracovanie hotovosti) returned vendor marketing pages and generic procurement portals, but no individual ATM/CIT tender or award notice surfaced in general web results.
negative_findings.result_summary: General search engines do not index the deep contents of the ÚVO Vestník, EKS, JOSEPHINE or ERANET well enough to find individual payments-infrastructure notices; the notices must be reached by querying those systems directly with CPV and keyword filters.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that a search-engine-only collection strategy would produce near-zero coverage for this cell; budget must go to in-portal querying and API access instead.

negative_findings.description: The largest ATM fleets, POS estates and card-personalisation volumes in Slovakia sit with private commercial banks (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB) and acquirers (Global Payments Slovakia, Worldline, SKPAY), none of which are contracting authorities publishing in the Vestník.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for POS terminal supply and card personalisation returned only commercial product pages, not tenders. No public tender channel was found for these buyers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The commercially most valuable payments-infrastructure demand in SK is structurally invisible to A2 procurement monitoring; it must be tracked via a different workstream (vendor announcements, references, corporate registry, RFP rumours).

negative_findings.description: The seed query on payment gateway / instant payment integration contracts (zákazka platobná brána integrácia okamžité platby SEPA) yielded regulatory and association material (NBS, SBA) but no procurement notices and no settled Slovak tender wording for gateway integration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found the regulatory driver and its deadlines, not the procurement artefacts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The glossary for gateway/instant-payment procurement in SK is unproven; keyword crawlers built on guessed terms (platobná brána, integrácia okamžitých platieb) risk silent misses until validated against real notice text.

negative_findings.description: One search result for the ÚVO root domain was titled 'Error', suggesting the portal intermittently serves error pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as an unverified hypothesis, not evidence the portal is down. No fetch was performed to confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector must tolerate transient failures on the single most important source rather than marking it dead; retry-with-backoff and alerting on sustained failure are required.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak independent ATM deployer (e.g. Euronet-type IAD) procurement or tender channel was identified within this cell's searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not searched to exhaustion; no evidence found either way.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Independent ATM deployers are a distinct buyer class for ATM hardware and CIT services; their absence from the map is a known blind spot rather than a confirmed absence.

coverage_gaps.description: Independent ATM deployers and non-bank cash operators (IAD model) in Slovakia were not mapped: no operator list, no procurement or supplier channel identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on SK independent ATM deployers (search: nezávislý prevádzkovateľ bankomatov, bankomatová sieť, výber hotovosti bez banky) and cross-check NBS registers of payment service providers.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV codes proposed for filtering (30123600 ATMs, 30162000 smart cards, 79710000 security services, 50000000 maintenance) were inferred, not confirmed against actual Slovak notices for ATM/CIT/terminal contracts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull a sample of 20-50 real SK notices from TED and the Vestník in these product areas and derive the CPV distribution empirically before locking the collector's filter set.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial bank and acquirer procurement (the bulk of POS, card personalisation and ATM-estate spend) has no public tender channel, leaving A2 monitoring blind to the highest-value deals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Escalate to a non-procurement workstream: track vendor press releases and case studies (Global Payments SK, Worldline SK, SKPAY), bank annual reports, and corporate-registry contract signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Zákazky s nízkou hodnotou (low-value contracts) — where most individual terminal, kiosk and servicing purchases sit — are dispersed across thousands of buyer websites and EKS, and are not comprehensively covered by any free source found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Either subscribe to a commercial aggregator with low-value coverage (tender.sk claims 40,000+ sources) or accept documented under-coverage of this layer and state it in every derived metric.

coverage_gaps.description: ERANET is deployed as many per-buyer instances and only the Slovenská pošta instance was identified; the rest of the instance list is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate ERANET (and similar) instances by crawling ÚVO buyer profiles for outbound e-procurement links, then register each relevant instance as its own source.

coverage_gaps.description: The most analysis-ready SK procurement dataset (UVOstat API) is token-gated with only /api/subjekty free; the rest is paid, and tender.sk is subscription-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide early between paying for UVOstat API access and building an in-house Vestník/TED extractor; consult the Slovensko.Digital 'dáta vestníka' thread for the current DIY route.

brief: Slovak payments-infrastructure procurement is legible almost entirely through four statutory layers — the ÚVO Vestník (notices), TED (above-threshold, structured, EN), the Centrálny register zmlúv (signed contracts with commercial terms), and EKS (low-value e-marketplace) — plus three private e-procurement platforms (JOSEPHINE, ERANET, eZakazky) that host the technical specifications for terminals, kiosks and gateways. The distinctive buyer set for this cell is not banks: it is Slovenská pošta (self-service cash kiosks, eKolok, Pay by square), NBS (cash-processing and payment-system IT, tendered via intermediary NAR marketing), and transport operators DPB and ZSSK (card-accepting vending kiosks, with DPB signalling a doubling of card-enabled machines by end-2026). The supply side is concentrated in CIT/ATM-outsourcing incumbents operating under NBS cash-processing licences (Loomis, Monilogi, SBS-licensed operators such as ProtectUs), which makes award-notice supplier tracking in UVOstat/TED a workable market-share proxy. Two structural limits must be stated up front: commercial bank and acquirer spend on POS estates and card personalisation has no public tender channel at all, and general web search does not reach inside these portals — collection must be in-portal, CPV-driven, and validated against real notice text before the query vocabulary is trusted.
